stem.text: Which diagram shows a couple formed by two forces, each of magnitude $F$, acting on a rod?

A.alt: Horizontal rod with a downward arrow labelled F at each end.

B.alt: Horizontal rod with a downward arrow labelled F at its left end and a diagonal arrow labelled F at its right end.

C.alt: Horizontal rod with a downward arrow labelled F at its left end and a rightward arrow labelled F at its right end.

D.alt: Horizontal rod with an upward arrow labelled F at its left end and a downward arrow labelled F at its right end.
